description: Function inspection, spoofing, and stealth utilities.

functions.name: spoof
description: Makes `target_fn` appear as `spoof_fn` in debug introspection (e.g. `debug.getinfo`).
The spoof is recorded globally. Each function can only participate in one spoof relationship at a time.

params.name: spoof_fn
params.description: The Lua function whose debug info will be reported. Must be a Lua function, not a C function.

params.name: target_fn
params.description: The function that will appear as `spoof_fn` when inspected.

errors: Argument 1 must be a Lua function (not a C function).

functions.name: is_spoofed
functions.description: Checks whether `fn` is currently being used as a spoof target.

returns.description: `true` if the function is a spoof target, `false` otherwise.
If spoofed, the original function is also returned as a second value.

functions.name: mark_special
description: Marks a Lua function as a special (internal) frame.
Special frames are hidden from stack introspection unless `lje.env.show_special_frames` is enabled. Automatically applied to callbacks registered with LJE.
functions.note: You shouldn't need to use this unless you know what you are doing!

params.name: fn
params.description: Must be a Lua function, not a C function.

errors: Argument 1 must be a Lua function (not a C function).

functions.name: compile
functions.description: Compiles a Lua string into a function without executing it. If a global environment is set via `lje.env.set`, it is applied to the compiled function automatically. Returns `nil` on compilation failure.

returns.description: The compiled function, or `nil` if compilation failed.

functions.name: hide_caller
functions.description: Hides `fn` from appearing as a caller in stack traces.

params.name: fn
params.description: The function to hide from stack traces.

functions.name: type
description: Returns the internal LuaJIT fast function ID (`ffid`) of a function.
- Anything else is the unique ID of a fast function.

returns.description: The `ffid` value. `0` for regular Lua functions.
